name: hlgr360
description: Plugins for coding agents, published by hlgr360.

plugins.name: claude-mnemonic
plugins.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code and Claude Desktop: decisions, findings and fixes from earlier sessions, searchable and shared by both, with a local web dashboard. Fork of lukaszraczylo/claude-mnemonic.

plugins.name: local-llm-mcp
plugins.description: Offload code-shaped work (generation, review, refactoring, test-writing) to a local LLM: Ollama, llama-server, vLLM or LM Studio, with file-aware tools that read files server-side and an optional Read-gate hook. Fork of Jadael/OllamaClaude.
